title: Allele-inference attack against genomic data-sharing beacons

dimensions.source: Von Thenen et al., Bioinformatics 2019, Re-identification of individuals in genomic data-sharing beacons via allele inference
dimensions.limitations: Experimental beacon attack. In the reported simulated 65-person CEU beacon scenario with low-MAF victim SNPs hidden, the genotype-inference attack required five queries on average at the reported 95 percent confidence level. Query count measures attack efficiency and is not itself treated as D1 risk magnitude.
